title: Cover peers revoke JSON output in live tests
summary: Add opt-in live CLI coverage for `covenant peers revoke --json` so automation can trust the machine-readable Revoked, AlreadyRevoked, NotFound, and Ambiguous outcomes across the real daemon boundary.
expectedFailureModes: `peers revoke --json` prints human diagnostics alongside JSON and breaks parsers.
Successful and idempotent revocations produce the wrong exit status for automation.
The JSON outcome leaks full peer tokens instead of redacted prefixes.
nextAction: Integrated locally; next peer-auth live hardening should target forced self-revoke recovery only with isolated temp-home fixtures.
